units.source_text: 源中将常来访问这位亲王。

en.t: Genji the Middle Captain often came to visit this prince.

units.source_text: 每逢管弦之会，两人吹笛的本领不相上下，

en.t: Whenever there was a gathering for music, the two were evenly matched in their skill at playing the flute,

units.source_text: 互相竞争而又互相亲爱，真乃志同道合的青年伴侣。

en.t: competing with each other while also loving each other, truly young companions of the same mind and spirit.

units.source_text: 世人照例纷纷议论，竞称他们为“匂兵部卿、薰中将”。

en.t: As usual, people talked about them eagerly and came to call them Prince Niou of the Ministry of War and Kaoru the Middle Captain.

units.source_text: 当时家有妙龄女郎的高官贵族，无不为之动心，也有央人前来说亲的。

en.t: At that time, every high-ranking noble with a young daughter at home was moved by this, and some even sent intermediaries to propose a match.

units.source_text: 匂兵部卿亲王就中选择几个有意思的对象，探听那女子的相貌人品。

en.t: Prince Niou of the Ministry of War chose several promising candidates from among them and inquired into the appearance and character of those young women.

units.source_text: 然而特别中意的殊不易得。

en.t: Yet someone who especially pleased him was very hard to find.

units.source_text: 他想：“冷泉院的大公主倘能配我为妻，倒是美满姻缘。”

en.t: He thought, If Reizei-in's eldest princess could become my wife, it would be a splendid marriage.

units.source_text: 这是因为大公主之母弘徽殿女御出身高贵，秉性风雅。

en.t: This was because the eldest princess's mother, the Kokiden consort, was of noble birth and refined by nature.

units.source_text: 而据外人评判，公主品貌之优越也是世间少有的。

en.t: And according to the judgment of outsiders, the princess's excellence in both character and beauty was rarely found in the world.

units.source_text: 况且还有几个多少亲近公主的侍女，每逢机会，必将公主的情况详细告诉他。

en.t: Moreover, there were several ladies-in-waiting who were somewhat close to the princess, and whenever they had the chance, they would tell him about her in detail.

units.source_text: 因此他的恋慕之心越发难于忍受了。

en.t: As a result, his longing for her became harder and harder to bear.
